task: Identify the electrical energy output of a hydroelectric power plant named Itaipu Dam in 2024 using Wolfram Alpha.
answer:
FINAL: Wolfram Alpha reports Itaipu Dam’s electrical energy output as 89.5 TWh per year (3.222 × 10^17 joules), defined as “Average annual gross power generation.”
For the requested year 2024, the site returns this average via its “closest interpretation”; it does not provide a 2024-specific total in this result.
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=Itaipu+Dam+annual+power+generation+in+2024
